purpose: Teach: 引き取り/製法/未納/受け皿/賭ける/画策/押し付ける/強いる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、前任研究員の業務、本気で、絶対、引き取り、絶対、お願いするぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to take on the previous researcher's work. I'm serious. Please.
lines.style: Steady, direct command softened by respect. Weight on the first name. Measured pace. The gravity of trust being placed, not obligation being imposed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室独自の、本気で、絶対、製法、絶対、論文で、扱っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The lab's proprietary methods are well documented in our papers. Thank you for your confidence in me.
lines.style: Quiet assurance. Not deferential — competent. Even rhythm, careful articulation. He's confirming he understands the weight, not performing humility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究費の、本気で、絶対、未納、絶対、報告、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check on any outstanding research funding reports. Make sure nothing's been missed.
lines.style: Practical, no-nonsense. Short sentences, slightly clipped. Not harsh — just the tone of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の、本気で、絶対、受け皿、絶対、企業様、絶対、お声がけ、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're already in talks with companies about supporting the research direction. I appreciate you believing in this work.
lines.style: Steady professionalism with underlying warmth. He's reporting progress, not asking permission. Slight lift at the end — pride without ego.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究の成果、本気で、絶対、賭ける、絶対、価値、絶対、ある、絶対、テーマだ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: This research is worth betting on, Ren. The potential here is real. This is exactly the kind of project that matters.
lines.style: Conviction without pressure. Slower pace on 「価値がある」. He's not pushing — he's affirming. Almost paternal clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文発表の、本気で、絶対、画策、絶対、教授と、絶対、進めております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm coordinating with the professor on timing for our paper submissions. We're making progress.
lines.style: Methodical, grounded. He's thinking out loud slightly — organizing as he speaks. Steady, no uncertainty. Grateful but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任を後輩に、本気で、絶対、押し付ける、絶対、ことなく、絶対、自分で、絶対、引き受けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't put this all on the younger researchers. You own some of this responsibility too. Take it yourself.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Weight on 「自分で」. He's not lecturing — he's protecting. The tone of someone who knows burnout from the inside.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後輩に無理を、本気で、絶対、強いる、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、配慮しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm making sure the junior team doesn't get overloaded. I'm carrying my share.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. He's already been thinking about this. No flourish — just the simple statement of someone who's already chosen his path.
